next_steps.description: Suitable for mild symptoms with no warning signs.
recommended_actions: Seek medical advice if symptoms worsen or do not improve.

next_steps.description: Suitable when symptoms persist, recur, interfere with daily life, or need professional assessment.
recommended_actions: Arrange a consultation with a qualified healthcare professional.
Keep track of symptoms and their duration.
Share relevant medicines and medical history with the healthcare professional.

next_steps.description: Recommended when symptoms are concerning but there is no clear emergency warning sign.
recommended_actions: Seek urgent care if emergency warning signs appear.

next_steps.description: Recommended when severe or potentially life-threatening warning signs are present.
recommended_actions: Go to the nearest emergency department when appropriate.
Do not delay emergency evaluation while seeking general online guidance.
